title: Car Rental in Shanghai: Can Foreigners Rent and Drive?
seo_title: Car Rental in Shanghai: A Foreigner’s Guide
meta_description: Learn how foreigners can rent a car in Shanghai, which Chinese driving permit is required, what to confirm before paying and when rail is easier.
excerpt: Foreign visitors can rent and drive a car in Shanghai, but a foreign licence or International Driving Permit is not enough on its own. This guide separates the government permit process from the rental company’s booking rules.
